# Extraction-quality probe (e2e)

A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

extractor has existing positioning to connect to.

positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceFrame
positions.frame: What is owned versus merely rented when intelligence sits on a shared substrate — and what is the asset worth keeping?
positions.why: Both expressions share the same directional read: a semicolon/antithesis construction (register) that stakes ownership as the value at issue (autonomy, self-enhancement) and frames the relationship in market-pricing terms — substrate as commodity versus perspective/intelligence as the kept asset. The two lines are structurally and thematically parallel (src-2 sets up the owned/rented antithesis abstractly; src-3 cashes it out as substrate/perspective), so one directional read — ownership as the axis distinguishing what is commoditized from what is retained — spans both. No tension: they reinforce rather than contest each other.

placements.title: ownership of intelligence, not access to it, is the asset that persists
placements.frame: Does this expression treat what is owned or kept — perspective, intelligence — as the durable asset, against a substrate or access-layer framed as interchangeable commodity?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 jointly state a thesis future envelopes will keep feeding: intelligence that is owned is categorically distinct from intelligence that is merely rented, and within that distinction the substrate (shared, commoditized) is separated from the perspective (kept, owned, the asset). This passes the narrative grain test — it names a subject (the ownership/rental distinction as the axis of value) rather than reporting a one-time fact or measurement. The graph supplied is empty at every tier (no strata, no leaves, no surfaced positions cover this), and the focus section explicitly reports no witness-depth match for owned-vs-rented intelligence or the individually-owned-intelligence thesis, so nothing existing can be reused; this mint is standalone since nothing in the (empty) structure is even close enough to relate it to via lineage, and no hub or strata category currently holds anything adjacent.
